name: Helping Rebuild the Kingdom of Jude

steps.name: Helping Rebuild the Kingdom of Jude (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvic] in "Underground City Tartaros", then obtain a <Golden Apple>, <Secret Score>, and <Magnet Weapon>. Report to [Layer] in "Underground City Tartaros" afterward.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you for taking an interest in helping rebuild the Kingdom of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Tell me about it. If I can help, I'd like to...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Certainly. You may know that Jude seeks close cooperation with the various powers of Eastland.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Technically, part of Tartaros belongs to Jude. But reluctance to develop the desolate Amaloon Desert led to this area being abandoned as well.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then Shynic said something like, 'I'll do whatever I want here, all right?' and began developing it immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. That sounds like her...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then the Kingdom of Moss attacked Jude. Its reconstruction now requires considerable help.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I don't know about its relations elsewhere, but Jude is eager to cooperate closely with Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lord Basil of the Pesto estate on the eastern border is taking it so seriously that he sent his own daughter, Lady Violet.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I keep telling Shynic that we should maintain relations with Jude, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She thinks it's boring, I suppose?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes. She's been saying nothing is any fun lately...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: So I think we'll need some amusing objects. Perhaps something interesting would change her mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone who only acts if it's fun...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That's Shynic. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I've identified a few entertaining items. I'd be grateful if you could fetch them. If you can't, who knows what Shynic might do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Melvic, please don't say that, even as a joke...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll find them!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Once you have them, please bring them to Layer. Thank you.

steps.name: Helping Rebuild the Kingdom of Jude (2)
steps.objective: Obtain a <Traveler's Ring>, then report to [Jerix] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I've heard. I'm to look after whatever entertaining things you bring for Shynic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Here they are.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Then I'll put them safely in storage. But why are you staring at me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can sense your strength. You look like an exceptional fighter.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You caught me? Hahaha. I'm just a retired old man.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah, I haven't introduced myself. I'm Layer. I used to be a mercenary roaming the desert.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Now I run the warehouse in Tartaros at Shynic's request.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You look impressive yourself, bringing back all these things for her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a little difficult.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Why were you collecting these things, though?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Layer that Melvic asked you to do it.)

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: So that's what happened. If it's Melvic's work, I should help more... Why not secure promises of support from elsewhere, too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds wise.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Lord Basil helped me once. I'd like to repay at least a little of that kindness... Let's see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look pleased.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It brought back memories... Ah, if you came from Lumen, you must know Jerix?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Arrogant, haughty, and inconsiderate, but a flawless master of finance: Jerix, Lumen's head butler.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: So that's what people think of him now. He used to be so shy. Tell him I sent you. He'll take care of things.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: He might still feel a little hurt over me. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know the story, but it sounds like I shouldn't go empty-handed.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Then you'd better bring a gift. What would be good...?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah, this should do. A big pile of Traveler's Rings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all I need to bring?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Yes. He'll handle the rest. Enough to speed Jude's reconstruction along considerably.
All right. I'll go now.

steps.name: Helping Rebuild the Kingdom of Jude (3)

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: You still reek of blood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I heard you were leaving. Haven't you gone yet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to Tartaros, but something came up, so I'm back briefly.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Tartaros?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Layer had a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Who? Layer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He sent me to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Layer wants to repay Lord Basil of Jude's southern territory for his kindness. He thought asking you would do the trick...

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Aaaaah! How many decades is that boy going to milk this?! The rings keep multiplying every year.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Just because I was rejected doesn't mean he can hold it over me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh. So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 아리안느
lines.text: Pfft...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Entirely understandable, I think.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm... Rejected, then.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: How unfortunate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As the atmosphere takes a strange turn, you prepare to escape. Jerix catches you.)

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Sigh. Where do you think you're going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha. Nowhere. Nothing.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: No helping it. This isn't Layer's fault.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: It's all that Melvic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Melvic?)

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: He calls me his master, yet makes me do everything. Fine. Lumen will once again pledge support to Tartaros and the Kingdom of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Tell Melvic I'll increase the aid, so he can stop this! That wretch... How many times is this now?

steps.name: Helping Rebuild the Kingdom of Jude (4)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe. You've brought good news from Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Melvic what happened during your visit to Jerix.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe. My true master, as ever.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'll have to make use of this from time to time. He's helped so much already, and if he'll continue, I see no reason to refuse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In some ways, he's worse than Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe. What has you thinking so hard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Meanwhile, Shynic has promised aid to Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's wonderful!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It was worth waiting for Lumen's firm commitment. Please give Lady Violet the good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't you tell her yourself?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think it would be better coming from you, adventurer. A promise from a follower of a god inspires more trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: ...Oh, %s. Good to see you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Violet?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I've felt bad that I never properly thanked you for helping Jude before.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I heard you'd arrived in Tartaros. I'm sorry I didn't greet you sooner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Oh? What is it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that Tartaros and Lumen have pledged support for Jude's reconstruction.)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Really? Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Shynic seemed to be in such a poor mood lately. I was struggling to decide what to do.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: You've helped us again. Thank you, once more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it wasn't really... How should I put it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Melvic's grand design, perhaps.)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I must send word to Father immediately. Tell him our heroic adventurer has helped us once again...

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Our kingdom is blessed to have so many people helping. The Silvaria Empire in Freios has also offered aid, and we're waiting for it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Silvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Yes. I hear a noble empress rules there. Have you met her, adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. I haven't even been near the empire.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I see. If you visit someday, please tell me all about it.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: And whenever you visit our estate, we'll welcome you with a grand banquet. Thank you, always.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you again!
